result.instructions: Tools for Ably, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ably data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run ably_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ably_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ably_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. ably_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ably_get_channel_history
tools.title: Get channel message history
tools.description: Retrieve historical messages published to a channel, newest-first by default. REST: GET /channels/{channel}/messages.

start.description: Earliest message time, ms since epoch (inclusive).

end.description: Latest message time, ms since epoch (inclusive).

tools.name: ably_get_presence
tools.title: Get channel presence set
tools.description: List the members currently present on a channel (who is online now). REST: GET /channels/{channel}/presence.

tools.name: ably_get_presence_history
tools.title: Get channel presence history
tools.description: Retrieve historical presence events (enter/leave/update) for a channel. REST: GET /channels/{channel}/presence/history.

start.description: Earliest event time, ms since epoch (inclusive).

end.description: Latest event time, ms since epoch (inclusive).

tools.name: ably_get_channel_details
tools.title: Get channel details / occupancy
tools.description: Get status and occupancy metrics for a single channel (connections, publishers, subscribers, presence members). REST: GET /channels/{channel}.

tools.name: ably_list_channels
tools.title: List active channels
tools.description: Enumerate channels that are currently active in the app. Requires the API key to have the 'channel-metadata' capability. REST: GET /channels.

prefix.description: Only return channels whose name starts with this prefix.

by.description: Return channel ids only ('id', default) or full details ('value').

tools.name: ably_get_stats
tools.title: Get app statistics
tools.description: Retrieve message/connection/channel usage statistics for the app tied to the API key, bucketed by time. REST: GET /stats.

start.description: Start of range, ms since epoch (inclusive).

end.description: End of range, ms since epoch (inclusive).

unit.description: Bucket size: minute | hour | day | month. Default minute.

tools.name: ably_get_service_time
tools.title: Get Ably service time
tools.description: Return the current Ably service time in ms since epoch. Useful for aligning start/end windows to the server clock. REST: GET /time.

tools.name: ably_publish_message
tools.title: Publish a message to a channel
tools.description: WRITE: publish a message to a channel. Every connected subscriber receives it in real time. This is a real, outward-facing side effect — confirm the channel and payload before calling. REST: POST /channels/{channel}/messages.

channel.description: Channel name to publish to, e.g. 'chat:room1'.

data.description: Message payload (string; send JSON as a stringified value).

name.description: Optional event name for the message.

clientId.description: Optional clientId to attribute the message to.

annotations.title: Publish a message to a channel

tools.name: ably_whoami
tools.title: Get control token / account info
tools.description: Return details about the configured control token: the account and user it belongs to and its capabilities. Good first call to confirm control-plane access. Control API: GET /me.

tools.name: ably_list_apps
tools.title: List Ably apps
tools.description: List all apps in the account (id, name, status, tls-only). Account id is resolved automatically from the control token when ABLY_ACCOUNT_ID is unset. Control API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/apps.

account_id.description: Override the account id (defaults to the token's account).

tools.name: ably_list_keys
tools.title: List an app's API keys
tools.description: List the API keys for an app, including their capabilities (but not the full secret). Control API: GET /apps/{app_id}/keys.

tools.name: ably_list_namespaces
tools.title: List an app's channel namespaces
tools.description: List the channel namespaces (channel-rule prefixes) configured for an app, e.g. persistence and push settings. Control API: GET /apps/{app_id}/namespaces.

tools.name: ably_list_queues
tools.title: List an app's queues
tools.description: List the Ably Queues (AMQP/STOMP message queues) provisioned for an app, with their state and messaging stats. Control API: GET /apps/{app_id}/queues.

tools.name: ably_list_rules
tools.title: List an app's integration rules
tools.description: List the integration rules (reactor rules: webhooks, AWS Lambda/SQS/Kinesis, Kafka, Pulsar, etc.) configured for an app. Control API: GET /apps/{app_id}/rules.

tools.name: ably_get_account_stats
tools.title: Get account-level statistics
tools.description: Retrieve aggregated usage statistics across the whole account, bucketed by time. Account id is resolved from the control token when ABLY_ACCOUNT_ID is unset. Control API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/stats.

account_id.description: Override the account id (defaults to the token's account).

start.description: Start of range, ms since epoch (inclusive).

end.description: End of range, ms since epoch (inclusive).

unit.description: Bucket size: minute | hour | day | month. Default minute.
